(BY SHRI HARISH SHUKLA - PANEL LAWYER FOR THE RESPONDENT/STATE )
 (BY SHRI SOURABH SINGH THAKUR - ADVOCATE FOR THE COMPLAINANT)
 T h is application coming on for admission this day, the Cour  following:
 ORDER I.A. No.1634/2023 for assisting the prosecution is allowed.
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant is in custody since 27.12.2022 in connection with Crime No.27/2022 registered at P.S.
Kotwali, District Tikamgarh for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467 and 468 of IPC.
As per the prosecution, a complaint was lodged by the complainant that he was shown a land by 3-4 persons including the present applicant.

It was alleged that the land belongs to joint ownership of the applicant along with his family members and the agreement was executed between the complainant and the applicant for sale of his share, and accordingly amount was paid.

However,
later on, while taking out the revenue record, it was found that applicant has agreed to sell more land than his own share.
Feeling aggrieved, the complainant has lodged the complaint.

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is at least owner of half of the land that he has agreed to sell.
Therefore, the complainant may pay him less for that land and adjust the amount in the sale consideration as sale deed has not yet been executed.
It is further pointed out that it is a civil dispute which has been given a criminal colour.
Learned counsel for the applicant undertakes that the applicant will cooperate in the investigation and also during the trial.
Learned counsel for the complainant though opposed the bail application.
Considering the nature of the case, without adverting to the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.
It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
It is made clear that the applicant would cooperate in the trial and would appear on each and every date before the trial Court.

In case, if the applicant fails to cooperate in the trial and if he is found involved in any other offence during the pendency of the trial, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically and the concerned Court will be at liberty to take him into custody.
Certified copy as per rules.
